english_draft:
Intel reported Q4 2025 results on January 22, 2026.
Revenue was $13.7 billion.
Revenue decreased 4% year over year.
Full-year 2025 revenue was $52.9 billion.
Full-year revenue was flat year over year.
The company did not adjust these comparisons for Altera deconsolidation.
Altera was deconsolidated in Q3 2025.
GAAP diluted EPS attributable to Intel was $(0.12).
Non-GAAP diluted EPS attributable to Intel was $0.15.
GAAP net loss attributable to Intel was $0.6 billion.
Non-GAAP net income attributable to Intel was $0.8 billion.
Q4 cash from operations was $4.3 billion.
GAAP gross margin was 36.1%.
Non-GAAP gross margin was 37.9%.
CFO David Zinsner said Q4 exceeded expectations for revenue, gross margin, and EPS.
He said industry-wide supply shortages continued.
He said available supply should be lowest in Q1 2026.
He said supply should improve in Q2 2026 and beyond.
Client Computing Group revenue was $8.2 billion, down 7%.
Data Center and AI revenue was $4.7 billion, up 9%.
Intel Foundry revenue was $4.5 billion, up 4%.
Foundry revenue includes intersegment transactions.
All other revenue was $0.6 billion, down 48%.
The decline mainly reflects Altera deconsolidation.
Q1 2026 guidance: revenue $11.7 to $12.7 billion; GAAP EPS $(0.21); non-GAAP EPS $0.00; non-GAAP gross margin 34.5%.
Intel completed the sale of $5.0 billion of common stock to NVIDIA.
Intel 18A reached high-volume manufacturing in Arizona and Oregon.
There was no preview article before this release.
Therefore, this analysis does not compare actual results with a prior preview.
This analysis uses only the official earnings release.
reader_questions: Altera 出表如何影响同比和分部收入？若只看合并收入，Q4 营收降幅是否被 Altera 基数变化扭曲？
CFO 所说的“超预期”是指公司内部指引还是市场共识？新闻稿未披露具体预期值，读者不应自行假设。
Intel Foundry 收入 45 亿美元包含内部交易，不能把它直接理解为外部代工收入；外部客户收入应看哪一栏？
fact_checks: 日期与季度：新闻稿发布于 2026-01-22，报告期为 2025Q4（截至 2025-12-27）及全年。
Q4 合并收入 136.74 亿美元 vs 上年同期 142.60 亿美元，同比 -4%；全年 528.53 亿美元 vs 531.01 亿美元，基本持平。
同比未因 Altera 于 2025Q3 出表而调整。
GAAP 归属 Intel 净亏损 5.91 亿美元，摊薄 EPS -0.12 美元；非 GAAP 归属 Intel 净利润 8 亿美元，摊薄 EPS 0.15 美元。
毛利率：GAAP 36.1%（-3.1 ppts），非 GAAP 37.9%（-4.2 ppts）；经营现金流 Q4 43 亿美元、全年 97 亿美元。
分部（新口径已追溯调整）：CCG 82 亿美元 -7%；DCAI 47 亿美元 +9%；Foundry 45 亿美元 +4%（含内部交易）；All other 6 亿美元 -48%。
Q1 2026 公司指引：收入 117–127 亿美元；GAAP EPS -0.21 美元；非 GAAP EPS 0.00 美元；非 GAAP 毛利率 34.5%。
NVIDIA 购买 50 亿美元 Intel 普通股已完成；Intel 18A 已在亚利桑那和俄勒冈进入高产量制造。
无同期 Preview 定稿；本稿未使用财报后信息或外部共识数据。
